semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 7 Enhanced examination
WARNING
Uncontrolled system movement due to unintended signal activation by users!
Injury to the patient or damage to the system.
◆ Always observe the patient directly. Press the nearest STOP key immediately if an undesired system movement is performed.
WARNING
Unintentional patient movement!
Unintentional activation of the device by the patient.
◆ Always fix and observe the patient when using the device.
WARNING
Operation of the i-Control in the wrong examination room!
Injury to the patient or damage to the system.
◆ Always keep the i-Control at the associated CT scanner.
WARNING
Uncontrolled system movement due to unintended signal activation by users!
Injury to the patient or damage to the system.
◆ Always keep the activated intervention device at the CT scanner to prevent unauthorized use.
i‑Control can be mounted to both sides of the patient table. Therefore, the mounting fixtures must be attached to the patient table first.
If i‑Control is mounted at the surgical rail, the movement direction for the table joystick is set automatically.
1 Attach the guiding rod to the mounting fixture.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 387
7 Enhanced examination
2 Move the lever to tighten the guiding rod to the mount fixture.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Scrolling through the image stack
Image segment is selected.
The image‑scroll mode is active by default.
1 If the image-scroll mode is currently not active, press the Cursor / Navigation key to activate the image‑scroll mode.
The lower LED lights up.
2 Move the Mouse joystick up or down to scroll through the images.
The joystick direction corresponds to the scroll bar on the screen at the console.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 7.4.10 Setting a tube position for HandCARE
HandCARE helps to reduce radiation dose for operators inside the examination room.
HandCARE is only available in the i-Sequence and i-Fluoro scan modes. ( Page 195 HandCARE)
◆ From the HandCARE selection list, select a tube position - for example, 10 o'clock position - where the radiation is paused.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 405
7 Enhanced examination
HandCARE is displayed as watermark on the Intervention parameter card, on the scan mode icons for i-Sequence and i-Fluoro, and on the Routine parameter card.
If HandCARE is switched off, the maximum length of an i-Fluoro scan is 100 s. If
HandCARE is switched on, the maximum length of an i-Fluoro scan is 50 s.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 7.4.12 Defining the table repositioning
Via the items of the Table control selection list, you define the automatic table repositioning after each i-Spiral.
To define the table repositioning, there are prerequisites:
The i-Spiral scan mode is active.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 406
7 Enhanced examination
◆ Select No Feed to position the table at the end of the preceding i-Spiral.
– or –
Select Feed to Begin Position to position the table at the begin of the preceding iSpiral.
– or –
Select Feed to i-Sequence Scan Position or Feed to i-Fluoro Scan Position to position the table at the previous i-Sequence or i-Fluoro scan position.
The items Feed to i-Sequence Scan Position or Feed to i-Fluoro Scan Position are only available if i-Sequence or i-Fluoro has been scanned in the current intervention.

The image order on the monitor of the syngo Acquisition Workplace depends on the in-room monitor position and the patient position.

section.title: Switching to the 3D view mode
section.hierarchy_path: /Enhanced examination/Adaptive 3D Intervention/Using 3D Intervention/Switching to the 3D view mode

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 7 Enhanced examination
Switching to the 3D view mode
In an Adaptive 3D Intervention, the system provides two different 3D view modes.
Patient-oriented view

In the patient-oriented view, the 3D planes meet in the center of the volume. The axial, coronal, and sagittal planes meet in the target point. You can switch the axial image to the i-VirtualTilt projection. The i-VirtualTilt projection shows a virtual gantry tilt according to the needle.
Sagittal image plane
Axial image plane
i-VirtualTilt image plane
Coronal image plane

The needle path defines the i-VirtualTilt image plane. It displays the needle path completely. The i-VirtualTilt segment is framed in yellow. Instead of the cyan reference line, the image plane is displayed as yellow reference line in the other MPR segments.
Needle-oriented view
The needle-oriented view consists of an i-VirtualTilt image and a needle view image (view through the needle). The plane of the third image is orthogonal to the i-VirtualTilt and the needle view.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 418
7 Enhanced examination
Needle view plane
Third image plane
i-VirtualTilt image plane
Needle
◆ Click the Patient Oriented View icon on the Path tab card of the Intervention tool bar.
– or –
Click the Needle Oriented View icon.
